about: Dated notes shown on the Briefs screen. The owner decides what is listed. Each brief: id (unique, never reused), date (YYYY-MM-DD), title, body (blank line = new paragraph). Newest date first; adding one makes the 'N new briefs' box appear for everyone who has not seen it.

briefs.title: Settings, with a sandbox for the globe and map
briefs.body:
There is now a Settings tile on the home screen. It holds how you pin, sound effects, newsroom sound and Calm mode, which stops the wiggling and pulsing animations.

Under How you pin, Try the globe and Try the map open the real thing right there. Spin it, zoom in and drop a pin. Nothing is scored.

briefs.title: Your buttons are under your summary
briefs.body: After you finish a paper, the same eight buttons from the home screen now sit under your summary: Stats, Streak, Fill the Blank, Standings, Passport, Settings, Sign in and Groups.

briefs.title: Pin on a globe or a flat map
briefs.body:
You can now drop your pin on a spinning globe instead of the flat map. Tap a region to zoom in, then tap again to place your pin.

Pick the one you like in Settings. Your choice is saved on this device.
